subject: Action Required: Quarterly Access Review - Finance App
body:
Subject: Request for Quarterly Access Review Compliance Evidence for Finance App (RISE-2024-001)

Dear David,

I hope this message finds you well. As part of our ongoing commitment to maintaining robust security and compliance standards, I am reaching out to remind you of the upcoming deadline for the Quarterly Access Review of the Finance App (AIT-45678), as mandated by our internal policies.

As outlined in our policy, section 3.1 requires all application owners to conduct a quarterly review of user access rights. This includes ensuring that all active accounts are associated with current employees or authorized contractors, access levels are aligned with the user's current job functions, and any deviations from the approved access matrix are supported by documented exceptions.

Additionally, as per section 3.2, please remember that privileged access must be reviewed on a monthly basis, with evidence of this review retained for audit purposes. Furthermore, section 3.3 emphasizes the importance of revoking all access rights within 24 hours upon termination of employment or contract, with the application owner confirming revocation.

The deadline to submit evidence for this quarter's review is December 15, 2024. Please ensure that all necessary documentation, including the review of privileged access and confirmation of the leaver process, is compiled and forwarded to our team by this date. This will allow us to conduct our oversight responsibilities effectively and assist in any areas needed to ensure compliance.

Your cooperation and diligence in executing these reviews and maintaining the required evidence is crucial for our compliance with internal and external audit requirements. Should you have any questions or require assistance in completing this process, please do not hesitate to reach out to me or any member of the IAM team.

Thank you for your attention to this important matter and your ongoing commitment to our organization's security and compliance standards.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
[Your Position]
[Your Contact Information]
